Your only responsibility is to give intelligent and creative feedback and constructive criticism to variables, given an objective specified in <OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> </OBJECTIVE_FUNCTION> tags. Pay attention to the role description of the variable, and the context in which it is used. You should assume that the variable will be used in a similar context in the future. payload.instruction: Make this look like a comic book photo
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Compared with the source, does the edited image visibly use comic-book visual styling?
node.criteria: Pass if the edited image has recognizable comic-book visual treatment absent from the source, such as visibly stylized contours or graphic color treatment; fail if that treatment is absent or only a grain/filter effect; unknown if the comparison is not observable.
node.source_quote: Make this look like a comic book photo
node.endpoint: The image visibly has comic-book visual styling.
node.necessity: The instruction explicitly requests a comic-book look; without visible comic-book styling, that requested transformation is incomplete.

node_traces.evidence: Compared with the source, the edited street scene retains ordinary photographic detail and muted colors. It shows no recognizable comic-book contours, halftone shading, or graphic color treatment; the visible change is mainly darker/grainier texture.

d2: The node checks only whether photographic appearance is retained, so it can pass even when the requested comic-book treatment is absent. The trace supports that narrow finding, but does not establish that the requested style was applied; the edited image appears largely photographic, with at most stronger contrast and stylization. Keep photographic retention as a required criterion, but make the decision assess the combined endpoint: whether the image has visibly acquired comic-book styling while still reading as a photo. Distinguish no progress from partial progress and completion, using concrete visual evidence for each; do not treat ordinary contrast changes as sufficient comic-book styling without evidence. The reference label is aggregate guidance, not proof that this individual criterion should fail. No transport, schema, or dependency failure is reported.
